data.summary:
A Technical Product Leader with over 15 years of IT experience, including 5+ years as a Technical Product Manager / Product Owner driving end-to-end product development for enterprise and SaaS platforms. Experienced in defining product vision, roadmap strategy, product requirements, backlog prioritization, and delivering customer-centric solutions through Agile and cross-functional collaboration.
Strong experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Azure OpenAI, Prompt Engineering, AI-powered chat/voice solutions, Azure, Azure DevOps, API integrations, Copilot Studio, and Power Automate. Bridges product strategy and technical execution, with experience across Healthcare, Banking/Financial Services, Telecommunications, Network & Security, and enterprise SaaS environments.

raw_sections.summary:
About me
A Technical Product Leader with over 15 years of IT experience, including 5+ years as a Technical Product Manager / Product Owner driving end-to-end product development for enterprise and SaaS platforms. Experienced in defining product vision, roadmap strategy, product requirements, backlog prioritization, and delivering customer-centric solutions through Agile and cross-functional collaboration.
Strong experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Azure OpenAI, Prompt Engineering, AI-powered chat/voice solutions, Azure, Azure DevOps, API integrations, Copilot Studio, and Power Automate. Experienced in translating business problems into AI-enabled product opportunities, prototyping AI solutions, defining success metrics, and partnering with engineering and data teams to move AI capabilities from discovery and POC through product delivery and continuous optimization.
Bridges product strategy and technical execution, with experience across Healthcare, Banking/Financial Services, Telecommunications, Network & Security, and enterprise SaaS environments.

raw_sections.skills:
Generative AI | Agentic AI | RAG | Azure OpenAI | Microsoft Azure | Azure DevOps | LLM | Prompt Engineering | AI Product Lifecycle
1. Experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Azure OpenAI, Prompt Engineering, and AI-powered conversational solutions.
2. Designed and prototyped multi-step AI workflows, RAG-based solutions, tool-enabled automation, decision- support workflows, and controlled human-in-the-loop patterns.
3. Worked with Azure and Azure OpenAI to explore and prototype enterprise AI use cases aligned with business and operational requirements.
4. Defined AI product requirements, user journeys, success criteria, quality metrics, user feedback mechanisms, and continuous improvement approaches.
5. Experience using Azure DevOps for product backlog management, requirements, user stories, sprint execution, tracking, and Agile delivery.
6. Evaluated AI-enabled solutions using baseline performance, response quality, efficiency, user feedback, adoption, and business-impact metrics. Identified AI and automation opportunities by analyzing customer feedback, operational inefficiencies, product analytics, and business requirements.
Digital Product Management • Design Thinking • Project Management • Agile / waterfall/ DevOps • Technical Leadership • Technologies - C, C++, Java, SQL, Python, ETL and Databricks.
Tools
JIRA- Execution • Confluence- Documentation • AHA- Planning • Miro- Discovery
